status: engineering specification and packaging prototype; new network board is NOT a pin-complete schematic

dc.connector: AMASS XT150-M.G2.R + XT150-M.G2.B in one keyed two-pole panel carrier; source cable uses female contacts
dc.rating_conditions: 8 AWG; manufacturer rise <=30 K; final enclosure derating required
dc.input_fuse: 50 A DC-rated upstream harness fuse; coordination and cable protection to be qualified
dc.busbars: Existing 160x8x2 mm copper bars retained; internal bolted cable attachments replace exposed lugs
dc.input_budget_note: 40 A load plus isolated-control supply and separate 2.5 W LED logic; round to 45 A for housekeeping margin

control_supply.output_protection: 5 A Pi branch + 1 A HAT branch + 1 A switch branch; reverse blocking and overvoltage protection required before external powering
control_supply.isolation: 1500 VDC module rating; whole product functional isolation only, not a safety barrier claim
control_supply.trim: Fit trim resistor from manufacturer THL40WI adjustment note; verify 5.1 V at supply and >=4.75 V at Pi under load; do not exceed 40 W when trimmed
control_supply.pi_connection: Internal fused harness to HAT power input, then both Pi header pins 2 and 4 and multiple ground pins; no Pi USB-C power input cable; qualify header/socket and copper for 5 A; do not power both paths
control_supply.separate_LED_logic: Existing R-78E5.0-0.5 supplies P5V/PGND only; never connect it to SYS5V/DGND

network.name: Splanc MAX NET3
network.unused: PHY4, PHY5 and MAC6 disabled; follow manufacturer unused-pin termination guidance
network.magnetics: Three 1000BASE-T integrated-magnetics RJ45 jacks, four pairs each, voltage-mode PHY compatible; PHY-side center taps per KSZ9896C section 8.1, NOT tied to 3.3 V; exact jack MPN/pin map pending
network.oscillator: 25 MHz crystal and load capacitors selected from crystal CL and stray capacitance
network.management: Local small MCU boots switch independently of Pi; SPI 3.3V programming/debug header; disable unused ports and MAC, enable forwarding between ports1-3; Pi management optional, not on existing FPGA SPI CS
network.boot: Do not depend on Pi/Linux to start forwarding; controller + reset supervisor required; MCU MPN/firmware pending

pairs.rule: Continuous ground reference, symmetric transformer escape, no stubs, isolate cable-side copper from DGND

network.shield: Dedicated chassis/shield network for panel shells, jack shields and ESD return; deliberate EMC coupling to DGND; no PGND short
network.daisy_chain: Linear topology only; no passive forwarding when MAX is unpowered; avoid closed loop until RSTP is implemented/tested
network.qualification: Pin-complete schematic, exact magnetics, ESD devices, regulator sizing, boot image, SI and EMC remain gates; this is a board specification with CAD placement envelopes

panel.ethernet: 2x Neutrik NE8FDP CAT5e feedthrough, same west end as DC
panel.power: One mechanically keyed two-pole XT150 carrier, screw-retained from inside; split carrier prints as separate parts
panel.growth_reason: 38 mm service bay houses Ethernet backshells, isolated supply on power-board tongue and protected DC wiring; height unchanged

remaining_gates: Detailed power protection/trim circuit and module heat-rise test
Network pin-complete schematic and exact jack/MCU/regulator selections
Right-angle patch lead procurement and physical bend-radius/assembly test
XT150 keyed carrier dimensions against production samples and retention force
40 A LED load plus 35.2 W control thermal/EMC qualification
Power-board tongue and daughterboard support/copper keepouts into final electrical placement

localization.status: Specification and display envelopes only; not yet incorporated in the pin-level boards or base BOM
